steps.note: Two runners start at the head. The fast one takes two steps for every one the slow one takes — so when fast reaches the end, slow is exactly halfway: the middle.
Slow steps to node 1; fast leaps to node 2. Fast is always about twice as far along.
Slow steps to node 2; fast leaps to node 4. Fast is always about twice as far along.
